description: Units of the metric's values and bounds.
The series this metric is relative to (reference points) or calculated from (fishing pressure as a harvest rate).
Quantity a reference point is a multiple of.
First and last year the `mean` or `percentile` basis is taken over.
Percentile for `basis: percentile` (e.g. 25; 50 for the median).
Spawning potential ratio in percent for `basis: f_spr` (e.g. 40).
How fishing pressure in 1/yr (F) is summarized across ages.
Oldest age included. Omitted means a plus group.
Name of the survey or fishery the index comes from.
`true` if the metric's column has `_lower` / `_upper` bounds (in either CSV).
Denominators of the metric's ratio columns, e.g. `[limit_reference, b_msy]` for `spawning_stock/limit_reference` and `spawning_stock/b_msy`.
Free text for human readers. Never parsed.
